welcome_palace.text: Welcome, it is our absolute pleasure to have you with us. Your suite is ready.

checkin_name.text: Under what name is the reservation?

passport.text: May I see your passport, please?

welcome_drink.text: May I offer you a welcome drink?
Can I get you a welcome drink?

early_checkin.text: Your suite will be ready in one hour. Would you like to wait in the lounge?

card_deposit.text: We will take an imprint of your credit card, with no charge.

valet_luggage.text: May I have your luggage delivered directly to your suite?
Shall I take your bags up to the suite?

valet_keys.text: May I take your car keys? Our valet will take care of it.

car_ready.text: Your car is waiting for you at the entrance.

luggage_storage.text: We can keep your luggage until your departure.

fragile.text: Are there any fragile items in your luggage?

umbrella.text: It is raining: may I lend you an umbrella?

suite_tour.text: Allow me to show you around your suite.

turndown.text: Would you like the turndown service this evening?

pillow_menu.text: Here is our pillow menu. Which one do you prefer?

do_not_disturb.text: We will not disturb you while the "Do not disturb" light is on.

minibar.text: The minibar is complimentary during your stay.

wifi.text: The Wi-Fi code is on the card next to the phone.

dietary_req.text: Do you have any specific food allergies or dietary restrictions?

table_tonight.text: Would you like me to book a table for you tonight?
Want me to book you a table for tonight?

tasting_menu.text: Tonight the chef offers a seven-course tasting menu.

wine_pairing.text: Would you like the sommelier's wine pairing?

breakfast_time.text: Breakfast is served from 7 to 11 a.m.

room_service.text: Room service is available day and night.

dress_code.text: Smart attire is requested in the restaurant this evening.

bill_room.text: Shall I charge the bill to your room?

airport_transfer.text: Would you like a private transfer to the airport?

theatre_tickets.text: I can get you tickets for tonight's show.

private_driver.text: A private driver can be at your disposal all day.

restaurant_booking.text: I have booked a table for two at 8 p.m.

tour_guide.text: Would you like a private guide who speaks your language?

flowers.text: I can have flowers delivered to your suite.

spa_booking.text: Would you like to book a spa treatment?

spa_hours.text: The spa and the pool are open from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m.

massage_pressure.text: Do you prefer light, medium or firm pressure?

health_conditions.text: Do you have any health conditions the therapist should know about?

gym.text: The gym is open at all hours with your room card.

apology_delay.text: Please accept our apologies for the wait.

fix_now.text: I will take care of it immediately.

technician.text: A technician will be at your suite in ten minutes.

change_room.text: We can offer you another suite at no extra charge.

doctor.text: Would you like us to call a doctor?

lost_item.text: Could you describe the lost item to me?

noise.text: We are sorry about the noise. We are dealing with it right away.

late_checkout.text: Would you like a late check-out?

invoice_email.text: Would you like to receive the invoice by email?

see_you.text: Thank you for staying with us, we hope to see you again very soon.

great_day_sarcasm_check.pragmatic_neutral: I am very dissatisfied with this situation.

welcome_vip_honor.text: It is an absolute honor to welcome you to our establishment. Please allow me to personally oversee your comfort.

table_full_partner.text: I deeply regret that our gastronomic table is fully booked this evening. Please allow me to secure an equally exceptional table for you at our partner establishment.

impatience_apology.text: We completely understand your eagerness and sincerely apologize for this brief delay. We are taking immediate steps to resolve it for you.

wait_special_gesture.text: We are very sorry for the wait; please accept a special gesture from us.

st_weather_lagoon.text: The weather is gorgeous today, perfect for a visit to the lagoon.

st_weather_rain.text: It may rain this afternoon; perhaps you would prefer an indoor activity?

st_excursion_sunny.text: The weather looks glorious for your excursion this afternoon.

st_good_trip.text: Did you have a good trip?

st_first_visit.text: Is this your first visit to the area?

st_sunset.text: Don't miss tonight's sunset from the terrace; it is superb.

st_hot_day.text: It is very hot today; remember to drink plenty of water.

st_enjoy_stay.text: I hope you are enjoying your stay.

eq_bags_room.text: Can you take the bags up to the room? It's urgent.

eq_room_ready.text: The room is ready, you can let the guest know.

eq_car_front.text: Bring the car round to the entrance, the guest is coming down.

eq_help_reception.text: I need help at reception, right now.

eq_towels.text: The suite is missing towels, can you bring some up?

eq_water_leak.text: There's a water leak in the bathroom, call maintenance.

eq_vip_soon.text: The VIP guest arrives in ten minutes, everyone in position.

eq_break_cover.text: I'm taking my break, can you cover for me for fifteen minutes?

eq_taxi_booked.text: The taxi's booked, it'll be here in five minutes.

eq_thanks.text: Thanks for your help, good job!

st_weather_region.text: The weather looks wonderful today for exploring the area.

delay_smoothing.text: Please accept our apologies for this brief delay. We are taking care of it immediately.
